sources.description: New Jersey outlet covering the five-alarm fire at the vacant Galaxie Chemical Corporation plant in Paterson, a Superfund site abandoned since 2006, with details on squatters' debris fueling the blaze, low water pressure challenges, and the building's demolition after the fire.
